scope: All primary, secondary, reference, validation-qualification and perturbation comparisons; no fitting/scoring performed by authoring this schema.

overflow.reason: true nonrepresentable positive absolute error after stable arithmetic

absolute_scores.rule: Retain all admitted absolute per-mouse and aggregate scores, including positive_infinity. NaN, signed Infinity JSON literals, clipping and substitution are forbidden. Complete finite predictions are distinct from finite error metrics.

derived_record.rule: Signed infinities or undefined mathematical outcomes are classified in metadata only; they never become numeric values or usable finite evidence.

per_mouse_difference: For A minus B, if both absolute scores are finite and stable subtraction is finite, emit the finite difference. If A=+infinity and B finite, emit unavailable/absolute_positive_infinity_operand with arithmetic_class positive_infinity; reverse gives negative_infinity. If both are +infinity, emit unavailable/indeterminate_infinity_minus_infinity with arithmetic_class undefined. Finite operands whose difference cannot be represented give unavailable/derived_arithmetic_overflow and its sign class. Keep every original mouse record.
aggregate_contrast: Require all expected paired mice (19 query or 15 validation) and every per-mouse difference finite. Otherwise the whole contrast is unavailable, with the complete affected-mouse reason list; no subset average or resampling. If all differences are finite, calculate their stable equally weighted mean; any nonrepresentable result makes the whole contrast unavailable/derived_arithmetic_overflow. No dropping, clipping or score replacement.
gain: Require technically and empirically qualified T, query equivalence, complete sealed predictions, and finite aggregate candidate and timing-reference scores with R_T>0. Otherwise gain=null/status unavailable with reference_unqualified, absolute_positive_infinity_operand or undefined_zero_reference as applicable. Compute 1-R_candidate/R_T with stable arithmetic only after these checks; nonrepresentable ratio/gain yields unavailable/derived_arithmetic_overflow (normally negative_infinity class). A positive-infinity candidate never receives numeric negative infinity gain. All absolute scores remain unchanged.

bootstrap.prerequisite: All expected per-mouse differences and aggregate contrast finite. If not, interval=null/status unavailable/required_comparison_unavailable, draw_indices=null, resamples_executed=0. Record planned seed and 10000 planned resamples without claiming execution.
bootstrap.finite_route: Use the fixed PCG64 seed and 10000 whole-mouse paired draws from V1. Each resample uses a stable finite mean. Percentile linear interpolation uses a stable convex combination of finite bracketing endpoints, never an overflowing high-low shortcut.
bootstrap.arithmetic_failure: Any nonfinite resample or endpoint despite finite prerequisites makes the entire interval unavailable/derived_arithmetic_overflow. Retain every generated draw and the failed operation; no redraw, finite-only subset, default endpoint or NaN library fallback.
bootstrap.record: Complete interval record contains status, endpoints or null, reasons, planned/actual draw counts and draw-index binding. Per-mouse absolute and finite difference records remain available.

validation_selection: All 28 fitted-model prediction vectors must remain complete and finite. Each validation absolute score may be finite or positive_infinity; retain all 28 results. Within a 14-model view, finite scores rank before +infinity; exact finite ties retain V1 L-before-Q/larger-lambda rule. If a view has no finite score, selection is unavailable and the attempt terminates before dependent selected-model/query/candidate work; this is numeric selection unavailability, not a missing-output or isolation failure. Infinity-scored models are retained as ranked outcomes, not omitted members.
qualification: The exact V1 T and N thresholds are unchanged. A required difference, mean or interval unavailable under this policy yields empirical_status not_demonstrated_numeric_unavailable, never pass or a favorable subset. Finite criterion failure yields not_met; finite pass yields met. RC00 requires both T and N empirical_status met. Diagnostic unsupported perturbation matching is separate from these statuses.

distinct_failures.missing_output: Incomplete/nonfinite prediction values or absent required identities fail admission; no absolute score is manufactured. Whole intended cohort stays in failure record.
distinct_failures.scientific_isolation_failure: Invalid custody or forbidden access invalidates scientific interpretation and blocks trusted target opening/scoring; it is not a poor model performance.
distinct_failures.nonfinite_metric: Complete finite admitted predictions can yield a genuine +infinity absolute score; retain it, suppress unsupported derived comparisons, and do not recast this as missing output or an isolation breach.
